messages:
micah: Quick decision needed for the 3-day mini: (A) fix embed parsing bug that’s causing errors for a handful of paying customers, or (B) ship the onboarding modal micro-improvements that improve new-user activation. Which do we take?

tara: My vote is A. Tickets from two enterprise customers and SRE alert show increased error rate.

diego: +1 for A. Repro in staging takes ~20m. I can spike a fix today and keep it scoped.

kelly: Data point: modal micro-improvements lift new-user activation ~2.6% but only affect new signups. Embed bug impacts existing customers and causes support load. Prioritize bug.

micah: If we pick the bug, we need to ensure it's a single small PR and not a refactor. Target: canary within 24 hours. Anyone object?

tara: No objections. Plan: 1) reproduce + write failing test; 2) add defensive parsing + graceful fallback; 3) integration test; 4) canary + monitor. Estimate 1.5-2 dev days.

diego: I'll add the failing test and the minimal guard. If CI flakes I may need extra half-day.

kelly: I'll move the modal ticket to backlog labeled "wave-b" and add acceptance criteria so we can pick it up later without re-scoping.

micah: Ops note: make sure SLI watch includes embed_error_rate and embed_p99_latency. Can ops-bot create a temporary dashboard card for the canary cohort?

ops-bot: Dashboard card created: "canary-embed-cohort". Alert thresholds set for embed_error_rate > 0.5% and p99 latency > 800ms.

tara: Customer comms: I'll draft a short note to affected tenants to say a fix is rolling and we'll follow up after canary.

diego: Opening WIP branch hotfix/embed-parse-guard and PR now. Repro command in case you want to run locally:

```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embed -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV' -d '{"input":"\u0000edge-case\u0000"}'
```

micah: Action recap: Diego -> PR + tests; Tara -> customer note + comms; Kelly -> move modal to Wave B; Micah -> update roadmap board & blockers. Target: verify canary within 24h of deploy. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
